title: Owner half · the co-founders (plugs into the keeper intro)
technique: The keeper intro (H240 take 2, 0-15 s) is never re-rendered. One 15 s owner-only take starts from its last frame, follows a 5-panel line-art storyboard, and is stitched on for free; tags and music go in the edit.
story: 0-15 s · Keeper intro (H240 take 2, unchanged): the cat lady can't find whether Fig & Cedar is safe for cats and leaves; the High flip lands on the owner at her desk.
15-18 s · The camera pulls back: her co-founder sits beside her. She, quiet and sad, almost to herself: “Damn... what's going on with Fig and Cedar?”
18-21 s · He leans back, arms crossed, cocky: “Yeah, I told you. Customers just aren't into Fig and Cedar.”
21-23 s · She, amazed, hand on her chest: “Damn, you just know things.” CEO and VISIONARY tags pop on them (in the edit).
23-24 s · She clicks the red X: Fig & Cedar is deleted. 24-27 s · She blows out the candle; Scout: “Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy.”
27-30 s · End screen: “Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.”

shots.what: Panel 1. From the intro's last frame, the camera pulls back into a two-shot revealing him beside her; she slumps, chin in hand, staring sadly at the laptop; he sits relaxed. (Ad time 15-18 s.)
shots.line: Damn... what's going on with Fig and Cedar?
shots.speaker: Owner (on camera, quiet, sad)

shots.what: Panel 2. Hard cut, on him: leans back, arms crossed, cocky grin; she turns to him, lips closed. (18-21 s.)
shots.line: Yeah, I told you. Customers just aren't into Fig and Cedar.
shots.speaker: Co-founder (on camera)

shots.what: Panel 3. Hard cut, on her: hand on her chest, amazed; he smirks, lips closed. CEO / VISIONARY tags added in the edit. (21-23 s.)
shots.speaker: Owner (on camera)

shots.what: Panel 4. Hard cut, over her shoulder: her cursor clicks the red X on Fig & Cedar (212 in stock, 3 sales); the row disappears. (23-24 s.)
Panel 5. Close-up: she blows out the jar; the wicks smoke. (24-27 s.)
shots.line: Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy.
shots.speaker: Scout (off screen)

shots.what: Hard cut to the H158 end screen. (27-30 s.)
shots.line: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
shots.speaker: Scout (off screen)
